title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. It retains resume parity checks for sealed agent-transition lineages and the Gauntlet Survival Card. Version 0.43.0 adds the Evidence Supply Line: a generic admitted CLI wrapper records exact workspace deltas, bounded execution facts, explicit independent-validator results, and immutable Agent License evidence without retaining prompts or raw output. A deterministic Gauntlet draft command proposes inert promise candidates from real repository structure and withholds HTTP commands it cannot derive. An optional Claude Code plugin hash-chains bounded PreToolUse and Stop metadata. Release media retains the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: the recorder observes a process; it does not sandbox it, authenticate an external identity, enforce network or credential policy, approve, repair, merge, publish, deploy, sign, or message. DRAFT Gauntlet artifacts cannot execute until human-reviewed promotion and a separate named, expiring admission. A passing receipt proves only the supplied admitted run and declared checks.
